_note: Week of August 24-30, 2026 — built around a 3lb pork loin and chicken thighs on hand. Same soy-ginger-sesame-garlic palette as the week you liked, but reworked: pork loin instead of tenderloin (roasted whole Monday, sliced leftover for Tuesday's lettuce wraps), chicken thighs instead of breast for both Thursday's stir-fry and Jake's lunch batch (holds up better to reheating). Wednesday breaks from soy for a lemon-garlic salmon. Sunday swaps the fried rice for masala egg bhurji and besan chilla. Reduced-sodium soy sauce throughout; scallions and onion cooked in, not raw. No mushrooms, lentils, okra, eggplant, or farro. Jake's lunch stays saucy and reheat-friendly with broccoli, not spinach. Laine's lunch is the standing tuna jar.

tzatziki.name: Sesame-Garlic Sauce
tzatziki.note: This week's tzatziki-slot sauce — soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, honey, and garlic. Goes on Tuesday's lettuce wraps. Makes about ½ cup (6 servings of ~2 tbsp), keeps 1-2 weeks refrigerated.
steps: Mince or grate the garlic directly into a jar or bowl.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and honey.
Whisk or shake until combined.
Keeps well refrigerated — shake before using.

dinners.name: Garlic-Ginger Soy-Glazed Pork Loin with Roasted Broccoli & Rice
dinners.note: Not a fish night. Whole pork loin roasted and sliced, extra cooked alongside for Tuesday's wraps.

ingredients.item: Pork loin — Jake 320g, Laine 190g raw (reserve ~340g extra, sliced, for Tuesday)
Soy sauce, reduced sodium — Jake 1½ tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Honey — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Rice vinegar — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ¾ tsp
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine scant ¾ tbsp
Sesame seeds — Jake ½ tbsp, Laine scant ½ tbsp

steps: Whisk soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, garlic, and ginger into a glaze.
Rub the whole pork loin (Monday's portion plus Tuesday's reserved piece) with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Sear on all sides in a hot oven-safe pan.
Brush generously with the glaze, transfer to a 400°F oven, roasting to 145°F internal (about 20-25 min depending on thickness). Baste once halfway.
Toss broccoli with a little olive oil and roast alongside for the last 15 min. Cook the rice.
Rest the pork 5 min, slice. Top with sesame seeds. Set aside Tuesday's portion before serving.

dinners.name: Pork & Shrimp Lettuce Wraps with Sesame-Garlic Sauce
dinners.note: Leftover Monday pork plus a shrimp treat, same standing Pita Tuesday structure in romaine cups.

ingredients.item: Reserved pork loin from Monday — Jake 210g, Laine 130g, sliced thin
Frozen shrimp — Jake 150g, Laine 95g raw, peeled, chopped
Romaine lettuce — Jake 100g, Laine 80g, leaves separated for cups
Scallions — Jake 35g, Laine 30g, sliced (cooked into the filling)
Sesame oil — Jake scant ½ tbsp, Laine ¼ tbsp
Sesame-Garlic Sauce — Jake ~1¾ servings, Laine ~1¼ servings (see recipe card)

steps: Reheat the sliced pork in a hot pan with sesame oil.
Add shrimp, garlic, carrots, and scallions, stir-fry 3-4 min until shrimp is opaque.
Toss with Sesame-Garlic Sauce to coat.
Separate romaine leaves into cups. Spoon filling in, serve with extra sauce on the side.

dinners.name: Lemon-Garlic Salmon with Bok Choy & Broccoli
dinners.note: Fish night. A fresh break from soy this week — lemon, garlic, olive oil.

ingredients.item: Bok choy — Jake 160g, Laine 130g, halved lengthwise
Lemon juice — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine scant ¾ tbsp

steps: Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, and garlic. Rub over the salmon on a lined sheet pan.
Bake at 400°F 12-15 min until it flakes easily.
Steam or stir-fry the bok choy and broccoli with a little olive oil and garlic until just tender.
Cook the rice. Jake gets the bigger fillet.

dinners.name: Sesame-Ginger Chicken Thigh Stir-Fry
dinners.note: Free night. Chicken thighs instead of breast — more forgiving in a stir-fry, same format as usual.

ingredients.item: Chicken thighs, boneless skinless — Jake 270g, Laine 170g raw, cubed
Soy sauce, reduced sodium — Jake 1½ tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Sesame oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine scant ¾ tbsp
Sesame seeds — Jake scant ½ tbsp, Laine ⅓ tbsp

steps: Cook the quinoa.
Sear the chicken thighs in sesame oil over high heat until browned and cooked through, remove.
In the same pan, stir-fry carrots, bell pepper, broccoli, garlic, and ginger 4-5 min until crisp-tender.
Return the chicken, add soy sauce, toss to coat. Serve over quinoa, top with sesame seeds.

dinners.name: Garlic-Soy Cod & Shrimp Stir-Fry

ingredients.item: Frozen shrimp — Jake 120g, Laine 80g raw, peeled
Frozen cod — Jake 140g, Laine 95g raw, cubed
Soy sauce, reduced sodium — Jake 1½ tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Sesame oil — Jake scant 1 tbsp, Laine scant ⅔ tbsp
Sesame seeds — Jake scant ½ tbsp, Laine ¼ tbsp

steps: Cook the quinoa.
Stir-fry the cod and shrimp in sesame oil until just opaque, remove.
Add bell pepper, carrots, garlic, and ginger to the pan, stir-fry 3-4 min until crisp-tender.
Return the seafood, add soy sauce, toss gently to coat. Serve over quinoa, top with sesame seeds.

dinners.name: Sesame Tofu & Vegetable Stir-Fry

ingredients.item: Tofu (firm) — Jake 260g, Laine 200g, pressed and cubed
Soy sauce, reduced sodium — Jake 1½ tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Sesame oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine scant 1 tbsp
Sesame seeds — Jake ½ tbsp, Laine scant ½ tbsp

steps: Press and cube the tofu. Cook the quinoa.
Pan-sear the tofu in sesame oil until golden on a couple sides, remove.
Stir-fry broccoli, carrots, bok choy, garlic, and ginger 4-5 min until crisp-tender.
Return the tofu, add soy sauce, toss gently. Serve over quinoa, top with sesame seeds.

dinners.name: Masala Egg Bhurji & Besan Chilla
dinners.note: Breakfast-for-dinner. A change of pace from the last few weeks' fried rice.

ingredients.item: Yellow onion — Jake 50g, Laine 40g, finely diced, cooked
Garam masala/turmeric/cumin/coriander spice mix — Jake 1½ tsp, Laine 1 tsp
Butter — Jake 1 tsp, Laine scant 1 tsp

steps: Bhurji: sauté onion in butter until soft, add garlic, ginger, tomatoes, and spice mix, cook 2-3 min.
Add beaten eggs, scramble until just set.
Chilla: whisk besan with water into a thin batter, season with a pinch of the spice mix and salt.
Cook chilla like a thin pancake in a lightly oiled nonstick pan, 2-3 min per side.
Serve bhurji alongside the chilla.

jakeLunch.name: Teriyaki Chicken Thigh & Quinoa Bowl
jakeLunch.note: Sunday-batch, 5 containers, no fish. Same reheat-friendly format, different sauce this time — a soy-honey-garlic-ginger teriyaki glaze instead of the plain soy-ginger-sesame from last time. Broccoli, not spinach.

ingredients.item: Chicken thighs, boneless skinless — ~3.5 lbs total (320g raw per container)
Soy sauce, reduced sodium — 1 tbsp per container
Sesame oil — scant 1 tbsp per container
Sesame seeds — scant ½ tbsp per container

steps: Cook all the quinoa at once.
Whisk soy sauce, honey, garlic, and ginger into a teriyaki glaze.
Cube the chicken thighs. Sear in batches in sesame oil until browned and cooked through.
Add broccoli and carrots to the pan, stir-fry 4-5 min until just tender.
Return the chicken, add the glaze, toss to coat and let it reduce slightly, 1-2 min.
Divide quinoa and the chicken mixture evenly across 5 containers. Top with sesame seeds.

laineLunch.name: Cold Tuna & Black Bean Mason Jar
laineLunch.dressingNote: Olive oil + lemon juice, kept separate and added just before eating.

ingredients.item: Canned tuna in water — 1 can per jar (5 cans total)
Black beans — ~¼ can per jar, rinsed
Avocado — ½ avocado per jar, added fresh when eating
Olive oil — 1 tbsp per jar (dressing, separate)
Lemon juice — scant ½ tbsp per jar

steps: Drain tuna, rinse black beans. Dice cucumber and bell pepper.
Layer each jar: black beans → tuna → cucumber → bell pepper.
Portion the dressing into a small separate container per jar.
To eat: add dressing and fresh-cut avocado, stir, eat straight from the jar.

laineBreakfasts.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl. Top with thawed berries and flaxseed.

laineBreakfasts.name: Spinach & Feta Egg White Scramble
laineBreakfasts.note: Kept as-is — same-day cooked, so it doesn't have the reheating issue lunch spinach had.

ingredients.item: Pinch oregano, thyme, cumin, paprika, salt

steps: Sauté cherry tomatoes 1-2 min in a dry nonstick pan until they start to soften.
Add egg whites, scramble over medium-low until just set.
Toss in spinach at the end. Top with feta and a pinch of spice mix.

laineBreakfasts.name: Birch Benders Waffles + Berries
laineBreakfasts.note: Standing Sunday-morning waffles, separate from Sunday's breakfast-for-dinner — unchanged.

ingredients.item: Birch Benders pancake/waffle mix — ½ cup dry

steps: Mix batter: mix + egg whites + water per package. Stir in flaxseed.
Cook in a preheated waffle iron 3-4 min until crisp.
Top with thawed berries.

laineSnacks.name: Cucumber + Hummus
laineSnacks.desc: ¾ cucumber sliced + hummus for dipping.

laineSnacks.name: Greek Yogurt + Berries
laineSnacks.desc: 1 Oikos Triple Zero + small handful thawed berries.

jakeSnacks.name: Cottage Cheese + Tart Cherries
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 cup cottage cheese + 1 cup frozen tart cherries, thawed — the uric-acid-friendly swap, kept in.

jakeSnacks.name: Roasted Chickpeas + Almonds
jakeSnacks.desc: ¼ cup roasted chickpeas + a small handful of almonds.

jakeSnacks.name: Greek Yogurt + Almonds
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 container plain Greek yogurt + a small handful of almonds.

Carrots — ~1.6 lbs / 1 bag (Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Jake's lunch)
